name: Suspicious Autorun Registry Modified via WMI
description: Detects suspicious activity where the WMIC process is used to create an autorun registry entry via reg.exe, which is often indicative of persistence mechanisms employed by malware.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Legitimate administrative activity or software installations
query: ((process.executable:*\\wmic.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:wmic.exe OR process.parent.executable:*\\wmiprvse.exe) AND ((process.command_line:*reg* AND process.command_line:*\ add\ *) AND (process.command_line:(*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run* OR *\\Software\\WOW6432Node\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run* OR *\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\Run*)))) AND ((process.command_line:(*\:\\Perflogs* OR *\:\\ProgramData'* OR *\:\\Windows\\Temp* OR *\:\\Temp* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp* OR *\\AppData\\Roaming* OR *\:\\$Recycle.bin* OR *\:\\Users\\Default* OR *\:\\Users\\public* OR *%temp%* OR *%tmp%* OR *%Public%* OR *%AppData%*)) OR (process.command_line:*\:\\Users\\* AND (process.command_line:(*\\Favorites* OR *\\Favourites* OR *\\Contacts* OR *\\Music* OR *\\Pictures* OR *\\Documents* OR *\\Photos*))))
